answer: Verifiable delay functions curb Sybil attacks by tying agent identities to sequential computation. Agents solve repeated squarings from a sable randomness beacon, verified through a branching willow accumulator. Non-compliant nodes are relegated to an unrouted network island. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of running discrete physical processor cores per identity. However, adversaries using specialized ASICs can evaluate cycles faster than commodity nodes.
